gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: TRAIN-only pixel runtime made no official submission or package; current competition-site rules were not revalidated for release.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: All 30 registered Linux episodes completed with zero invalid actions. Motion guard changed 11 actions and edge seek nine, exceeding the three-action floor. The other arms are reported, including reacquisition coast with only one change.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: On six matched TRAIN cells, motion guard and control both finished 6/6 with identical 24,670 ms median and no candidate-only lost finish. The core evaluator's linear P90 method gives 24,890 versus 26,700 ms; motion guard wins the first non-tied registered metric and advances to independent fresh TUNE only. The source report's floor-index P90 summary is preserved and corrected in metric_analysis.json. The improvement occurs in one cell, so generalization remains unproven.
